data.one_liner: Applies a gradient shadow overlay to images or widgets.
data.what_it_does: The shadow_overlay package puts a gradient shadow, default white, on your image or widget to make it fuse with the background. It is written entirely in Dart and works across all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You want to apply a gradient transparency effect over images or widgets
You need to fuse an image or widget smoothly with the background
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based animations or custom shaders outside of standard gradient overlays
You need advanced image editing or cropping capabilities
strengths: Straightforward usage with a single widget
Pure Dart implementation compatible with all Flutter platforms
Easy to integrate into existing layouts
weaknesses: Currently supports layout only from the bottom (per changelog notes)
Documentation is sparse and relies primarily on code tooltips
